CREATE TABLE test_results (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                score INTEGER NOT NULL,
                total INTEGER NOT NULL,
                percentage REAL NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL,
                duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE card_events (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                question TEXT NOT NULL,
                mode TEXT NOT NULL,
                correct INTEGER
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE quiz_answers (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                question TEXT NOT NULL,
                correct INTEGER NOT NULL
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE scenario_events (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                scenario_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                theme TEXT NOT NULL,
                correct INTEGER
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE project_events (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                project_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                correct INTEGER
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE ap1_events (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                scenario_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                theme TEXT NOT NULL,
                correct INTEGER
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE trainer_aufgaben (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                art TEXT NOT NULL,
                stufe INTEGER NOT NULL,
                correct INTEGER NOT NULL
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE pruefungen (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                art TEXT NOT NULL,
                punkte REAL NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL,
                dauer INTEGER NOT NULL,
                daten TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
            , uid TEXT, utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE abschlussprojekt (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                projekt TEXT NOT NULL,
                feld TEXT NOT NULL,
                wert TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
            , uid TEXT)

CREATE TABLE spiel_ereignisse (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                typ TEXT NOT NULL,
                daten TEXT NOT NULL,
                geraet TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                uid TEXT,
                lauf TEXT
            , utc_offset INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE spiel_plaetze (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                platz INTEGER NOT NULL,
                lauf TEXT NOT NULL,
                aktion TEXT NOT NULL,
                daten TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                geraet TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                uid TEXT
            )

CREATE TABLE spiel_bestenliste (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                durchgang TEXT NOT NULL,
                art TEXT NOT NULL,
                schluessel TEXT NOT NULL,
                wert REAL,
                daten TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                uid TEXT
            , utc_offset INTEGER)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_test_results_uid ON test_results (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_card_events_uid ON card_events (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_quiz_answers_uid ON quiz_answers (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_scenario_events_uid ON scenario_events (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_project_events_uid ON project_events (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_ap1_events_uid ON ap1_events (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_trainer_aufgaben_uid ON trainer_aufgaben (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_pruefungen_uid ON pruefungen (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_spiel_ereignisse_uid ON spiel_ereignisse (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_spiel_plaetze_uid ON spiel_plaetze (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_spiel_bestenliste_uid ON spiel_bestenliste (uid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_abschlussprojekt_uid ON abschlussprojekt (uid)
CREATE TABLE sync_meta ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)
